name: portfolio
description: Portfolio monorepo tooling: pf-web-* and pf-api-* builders and read-only reviewers for the Nx workspace (Angular 22 prerendered site, @vfortin/ui catalogue, NgRx SignalStore, Signal Forms, hexagonal NestJS services, Zod contracts, Docker, Nginx and Ansible), /pf-* commands, skills, and the guard, git-guard, delete-guard and Prettier format hooks. The plugin root is this .claude/ folder; the hooks only act inside a checkout whose package.json is named @vfortin/source.
